Present

Appeal has been filed under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 against the Award dated 16.12.2022, passed by learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal/Additional District Judge,
Kotdwar, District Pauri Garhwal in Motor Accident Claim Petition No.19 of 2019, "Nahid vs.
Subhash Chawla and Others", by which, learned Tribunal has passed an Award of Rs.28,26,645/-
(Rupees Twenty Eight Lakh Twenty Six Thousand Six Hundred Forty Five) as a compensation along with an interest at the rate of 9% from the date of institution of the petition till its actual payment.
2.

sentences.text:
Heard Mr. Bharat Tiwari, learned counsel for the proposed appellant and Mr. H.M. Bhatia,
learned counsel for the respondent no.1 - claimant.
3. Proposed Appeal has been filed by the insurer along with an Application to condone the delay of forty eight days' in filing the proposed Appeal.
4. The said Application has not been opposed by learned counsel for the respondent no.1 - claimant.
5. In the interest of justice, Delay Condonation Application (IA No.01 of 2023) is allowed.
The delay of forty eight days' in preferring the proposed Appeal is condoned.
At the request of learned counsel for both the parties, present Appeal is referred to the National Lok Adalat, which is scheduled to be held on 13.05.2023.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 09.05.2023 Pant/
